DiagnosticLevel.description: Payload size for diagnostics (independent of structural `detailLevel`).

oneOf.description: Plus raw traceback / full TD dumps.

OpPath.description: Operator path string passed to TD for resolution via `td.op()`.

Pid.description: OS process id — sole address for tools and queues.

oneOf.description:
Load — two different things, and `path` is what distinguishes them.

**With `path`** (a COMP to load into): loads the `.tox` at `target` with
`loadTox`, which is genuinely non-destructive. Measured on TouchDesigner
2025.32460: pages, parameter names, parameter types and a python
parameter's expression all survive the round trip.

**Without `path`**: reports what loading the file as the PROJECT would
mean, and loads nothing. `project.load(path)` returns `None`, so there
is nothing to verify a load against; it destroys the open project; and
there is no `open`, `revert` or `revertProjects` to undo it. A fresh
process (`spawn_td`) is the genuinely fresh load, and the daemon owns
that lifecycle.

The `path`/`no path` split is deliberate: replacing the session is
destructive and unverifiable, loading a component is neither, and one
verb covering both would make the safe case the unusual one to ask for.

SnapshotOverwrite.description: What to do when the destination already exists.

oneOf.description: Refuse. The default, and the only safe one to arrive by accident.

action.description:
What to save, or `status` to report without writing. Defaults to
`project`.

contextPath.description: Optional context path for resolving a relative `path`.

daemonId.description: Optional federated daemon id (omit for local / unique remote resolve).

diagnosticLevel.description: Diagnostic payload size (`summary` omits raw traceback).

overwrite.description: What to do when the destination exists. Defaults to `fail`.

path.description:
The COMP to save, for `action: component`; and the COMP to load
`target` INTO, for `action: load` with a `target`.

Meaningful in both directions, which is why omitting it is meaningful
too: `load` with a `path` loads a component, `load` without one only
plans a project load.

target.description:
Absolute output path. Required for both saving actions.

Not optional because TouchDesigner's own default is an *incremented*
name under `project.folder` — unpredictable, and therefore impossible
to put in a receipt.
